In addition to the [textlink="bar" link="Drinks"/], the shuttle is equipped with [textlink="hydroponics" link="Botany"/] and an abridged [textlink="kitchen" link="FoodRecipes"/]. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries."
# Tips on running LVHI Kilderkin shuttles - Optimal [bold]Target Power[/bold] (kW) for the generator unit is [color=#a4885c]30 [bold]kW[/bold][/color]. If you've added additional machines, check shuttle [bold]APC units[/bold] to monitor the shuttle's power draw and adjust the generator's [bold]Target Power[/bold] accordingly. For more general information on the power grid and other life support systems, refer to the [textlink="Электроснабжение" link="Power"] guidebook article and the [textlink="Предполётная проверка" link="PreflightChecklist"/]. - There are two buttons in the cockpit: the one with a yellow and black frame controls the window shutters. The button with the gray frame toggles thrusters and gyroscope.
- For the food and drink recipes, refer to [textlink="Рецепты еды" link="FoodRecipes"/] and [textlink="Напитки" link="Drinks"/]. - For the basics of growing food through hydroponics, refer to [textlink="Ботаника" link="Botany"/]. - For the basics of [bold]shuttle piloting[/bold], refer to [textlink="Пилотирование" link="Piloting"] and [textlink="Топология сектора" link="SectorTopology"/]. - As a Captain of a Nanotrasen vessel, you have the authority to hire, fire, demote, or promote crew members at will, refer to [textlink="Наём экипажа" link="Hiring"] for more information.
